definitions: People cannot change their fundamental nature or character, especially their negative traits.
It is impossible for someone to alter their inherent qualities or personality.
examples: He promised to be on time, but a leopard can't change its spots.
She keeps saying she'll be nicer, but a leopard can't change its spots.
Don't expect him to suddenly become generous; a leopard can't change its spots.
lemma: a leopard can't change its spots
synonyms: what's bred in the bone will come out in the flesh
source: a leopard can't change its spots
